Fields.Label: Sample Identifier
Fields.Description: Sample identifier for circulating tumor DNA assay.
Fields.Comment: Sample identifier for circulating tumor DNA assays.

Fields.Label: Biomarker Name
Fields.Description: param in bm_ctdna_vaf refers to the specific biomarkers being measured or analyzed. In this case, its gene name appended with the mutation as amino acid single letter code-position- replace amino acid code e.g. EGFR C799S.
Fields.Comment: Param refers to the specific biomarkers being measured or analyzed.Biomarkers are biological molecules that signify a normal or abnormal process, or a condition or disease. They can be used to see how well the body responds to a treatment for a disease or condition.

Fields.Label: Variant Allele Frequency
Fields.Description: This column gives Variant Allele Frequency (VAF). Variant Allele Frequency (VAF) is a key metric in circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) assays. It represents the proportion of DNA molecules carrying a specific variant compared to the total DNA molecules in a sample.
Fields.Comment: Variant Allele Frequency, indicates the abundance of a particular variant allele in the sample

Fields.Label: Variant Allele Frequency - Change from Baseline (CfB)
Fields.Description: This column gives change in the variant allele frequency from baseline for a particular mutation indicated by param. These values can be positive or negative.Positive values indicate an increase in variant allele frequency compared to baseline. Negative values indicate a decrease in variant allele frequency compared to baseline. A value of 0 indicates no change from baseline.
Fields.Comment: Varient allele frequency change from baseline, indicates how the frequency of a specific genetic variant has changed relative to its baseline value

Fields.Label: Variant Allele Frequency - Percentage Change from Baseline (CfB)
Fields.Description: This column gives percentage change in the variant allele frequency from baseline for a particular mutation indicated by param. Variant Allele Frequency % Change From Baseline, provides a relative measure of how much the variant allele frequency has changed compared to its baseline value.
Fields.Comment: Variant Allele Frequency % Change From Baseline, provides a relative measure of how much the variant allele frequency has changed compared to its baseline value.

Fields.Label: Mutation Status
Fields.Description: This column gives a mutation status for the sample from ctdna assays. Values indicating the detection status of a mutation: Detected indicates that the mutation is present in the sample. Not detected indicates that the mutation is absent in the sample.
Fields.Comment: mutation status, indicates whether a specific genetic mutation is present in a sample and this mutations associated with treatment response or disease progression can lead to the discovery of new biomarkers for treatment prediction
